scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @mesh2param/contracts typecheck && XDG_CACHE_HOME=.cache uv run --extra dev mypy engine services scripts tests
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @mesh2param/contracts generate:check && XDG_CACHE_HOME=.cache uv run --extra dev ruff check engine services scripts tests
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @mesh2param/contracts test && XDG_CACHE_HOME=.cache uv run --extra dev pytest
scripts.samples:generate: XDG_CACHE_HOME=.cache uv run mesh2param samples generate
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm samples:generate
